title: A game master bans and unbans an account and restores a deleted wizard in chat, and an account's chat level shows beside its name
notes: 6.05: the main account is made a game master and the companion's account is given menu chat only (0x23) on the game server's console before either logs in;
both enter the Commons as two-wizards.json has them, and the main wizard sees the filtered balloon beside the companion's name while the companion,
seeing the game master's default open chat, sees no mark. The game master types .ban account in chat: the companion is disconnected as banned and
its next login is refused with AccountBanned. After .unban account it logs in again; its wizard is deleted as its owner would delete it, its list
is empty, and after the game master's .character deleted restore and a relog the wizard is back on its select screen.
server_log_allowed: character_create_school holds no school, so no wizard can be created until it does
realmlist holds no realm, so no player can be sent to a gameserver until one is added
failed to authenticate as \S+: the account is banned
